constraints: If no minimum and/or maximum resizing limit has been set for the column (via LISTBOX SET COLUMN WIDTH), the corresponding minWidth/maxWidth parameter returns 0.

overloadMerges.note: minWidth and maxWidth are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as values filled in by the command (the column's resizing limits), not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current width (in pixels) of the list box column or column header, and optionally fills minWidth/maxWidth with its resizing limits, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

overloadMerges.note: minWidth and maxWidth are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as values filled in by the command (the column's resizing limits), not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current width (in pixels) of the list box column or column header, and optionally fills minWidth/maxWidth with its resizing limits, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
